core_question: Can a transient, non-proliferative recovery state in an extremotolerant biological system alter bacterial-cellulose formation before population growth becomes a confound?

public_evidence.source: Scientific Reports 2025, An anhydrobiotic cell line expressing odorant receptors shows odorant responses after dry storage
observations: Partial membrane/co-receptor function is detectable about 1 h after rehydration.
A de-novo-protein-dependent odorant response becomes significant from about 12 h and is recovered by 24 h.
Live-cell concentration is reported as stable through the first 48 h after rehydration.
Statistically significant cell growth begins at about 72 h and reaches a plateau by about 144 h.

public_evidence.source: Scientific Reports 2018, Transcriptome analysis of the anhydrobiotic cell line Pv11 infers the mechanism of desiccation tolerance and recovery
observations: Pv.07646, with similarity to Rad16, is specifically upregulated at R3.
NER-associated genes are active during dehydration and rehydration, including recovery-associated expression at R24.
HR, NER and NHEJ are implicated in the desiccation/recovery program.
The standard Pv11 induction protocol includes 600 mM trehalose pretreatment for 48 h.

public_evidence.source: PLOS ONE 2010, Anhydrobiosis-associated nuclear DNA damage and repair in the sleeping chironomid: linkage with radioresistance
observations: Physiological activity returns within about 1 h after rehydration.
Nuclear DNA integrity typically returns over about 72-96 h after rehydration.

public_evidence.source: Advanced Materials 2026, artificial living bacterial-cellulose composite
observations: A second living organism can become physically entrapped by growing bacterial cellulose.
The physiology of the second organism can alter local oxygen availability and spatial cellulose growth.
public_evidence.boundary: This does not demonstrate a Polypedilum or recovery-state effect.

lineages.name: Bacillus
lineages.imported_claim: repair/checkpoint activity is temporally associated with later replication/outgrowth

lineages.name: Adineta
lineages.imported_claim: somatic recovery can precede fuller genome restoration, with a distinct high-fidelity reproductive repair window
lineages.use_here: motivate separation of basic recovery from higher-risk reproductive restart

lineages.name: Polypedilum/Pv11
lineages.imported_claim: basic function and repair-associated recovery precede significant proliferation
lineages.use_here: primary lineage for the SCOBY mechanistic gate

imported_cross_lineage_context.rule: Cross-lineage generalization cannot be promoted in SCOBY-D0 until each lineage is provenance-bound to primary evidence.

polypedilum_time_axis.anchor: de-novo-protein-dependent functional recovery; NER-associated recovery continues
live-cell concentration still without significant growth versus 1 h baseline
whole-larva nuclear DNA integrity approaches restored baseline in classical comet/TEM work

primary_scoby_hypothesis.prediction: If a recovery-state signal affects Komagataeibacter cellulose deposition, a reproducible matrix phenotype should appear during R1-R3 before a proliferation-driven population increase can explain the effect.
primary_scoby_hypothesis.null: After controlling for medium carryover, trehalose, biomass, pH, oxygen and handling, R1-R3 exposures do not alter bacterial-cellulose production or architecture relative to matched controls.

readouts: fibril or bundle morphology where imaging is available
mechanical properties where material quantity permits

interpretation.whole_only: contact, surface, adhesion, nucleation or local oxygen mechanism favored
interpretation.neither: no detectable matrix coupling under tested conditions

phase_C_transient_state_memory.question: Can a short recovery-state exposure leave a persistent spatial layer in subsequently formed cellulose?
phase_C_transient_state_memory.design_principle: Apply a bounded exposure window, then return to matched baseline conditions and map the resulting material along the growth/time axis.
phase_C_transient_state_memory.promotion_requirement: A persistent, spatially localized material difference must survive removal of the transient biological exposure and remain distinguishable from pH, oxygen, trehalose and biomass controls.

trehalose_confound.reason: Trehalose is part of the standard Pv11 anhydrobiosis-induction protocol and can independently alter carbon availability, osmolarity and bacterial-cellulose physiology.
trehalose_confound.rule: No Pv11-specific matrix claim is admissible unless trehalose and medium carryover are quantitatively matched or removed and separately controlled.

pre_registered_decision_rules.pass_if: At least one R1-R3 condition shows a reproducible matrix change versus all relevant matched controls while cell number remains within the non-significant-growth window.
pre_registered_decision_rules.fail_if: No R1-R3 condition differs from matched controls.

pre_registered_decision_rules.pass_if: Matrix phenotype differs across R1-R3 states despite comparable viable-cell abundance or after normalization to viable-cell abundance.
pre_registered_decision_rules.fail_if: Phenotype scales only with increasing cell number.

pre_registered_decision_rules.pass_if: Whole-cell and cell-free comparisons identify a reproducible mechanistic direction.
pre_registered_decision_rules.fail_if: Effects disappear after carryover and handling controls or remain irreproducible.

pre_registered_decision_rules.pass_if: A bounded recovery-state exposure leaves a persistent spatial/material signature after return to baseline growth conditions.
pre_registered_decision_rules.fail_if: Any apparent layer tracks only bulk pH, oxygen, trehalose, biomass or handling differences.

kill_rules: If matrix changes begin only after the proliferative R4 window, reject NON_PROLIFERATIVE_RECOVERY_STATE as the explanatory mechanism for that effect.
If trehalose-matched controls reproduce the Pv11-associated phenotype, reject a Pv11-specific interpretation.
If matched medium carryover reproduces the phenotype, reject a cell-state-specific interpretation.
If repeated independent BC batches fail to reproduce the direction of effect, keep the gate closed.
If cell-free and whole-cell effects vanish after pH and oxygen matching, classify the result as MICROENVIRONMENT_MEDIATED rather than recovery-factor specific.

candidate_modifier_families.matrix_prediction: May change osmolarity, water organization, carbon flux and cellulose yield/structure.
Could alter hydration, interfaces or macromolecular stabilization; direct BC effect untested.
Could alter local redox/ROS environment; direct BC effect untested.
Primary role is intracellular repair; extracellular BC effect is currently speculative.
Could alter adhesion, entrapment, cellulose nucleation or local oxygen geometry.

janus_tranception.forward: REHYDRATION_STATE -> RECOVERY_PHYSIOLOGY -> CONTACT_OR_SOLUBLE_SIGNAL -> KOMAGATAEIBACTER_MICROENVIRONMENT -> CELLULOSE_DEPOSITION -> BC_MATERIAL_PHENOTYPE -> PERSISTENT_LAYER_TEST
janus_tranception.reverse: PERSISTENT_LAYER_TEST -> REQUIRES_SPATIAL_MATERIAL_DIFFERENCE -> REQUIRES_CONTROLLED_CELLULOSE_DEPOSITION -> REQUIRES_MATCHED_PH_O2_TREHALOSE_BIOMASS -> REQUIRES_DEFINED_RECOVERY_STATE -> REQUIRES_REHYDRATION_KINETIC_ANCHOR

next_action: Run or obtain matched early-window data focused on R1-R3 versus R4, with trehalose/medium carryover controls and whole-cell versus cell-free separation before making any claim of extremophile-conditioned bacterial cellulose.
